description:
A highly-concurrent, plugin-driven desktop environment engine.


v2.8.0: Activity Gate & Multi-Monitor UX 🎮🖥️
Welcome to Spice v2.8.0! This release introduces Activity Gate—an intelligent pause engine that automatically suspends wallpaper rotation while you're gaming, presenting, or on low battery—alongside a redesigned Multi-Monitor experience for macOS and Windows, active-display window placement, and instant Preferences startup on macOS.

✨ What’s New

🎮 Activity Gate (Automatic Game, Presentation & Battery Pause)
Spice now quietly detects when you need full system performance or zero distractions and pauses background downloads, image processing, and desktop transitions automatically:
- Fullscreen & Presentation Detection: Automatically pauses rotation when you launch a fullscreen game, borderless-windowed game, fullscreen video, or presentation on Windows and macOS—so you never drop a frame or get interrupted mid-meeting.
- Smart 3D GPU Detection (Windows): Senses sustained 3D GPU load from modern windowed-fullscreen games and pauses rotation automatically with zero manual setup.
- Custom App & Game Exclusions: Click Add App or Game... in Preferences to pick any .exe (Windows) or .app (macOS). Spice pauses whenever that application is in the foreground—even in a regular window—and resumes as soon as you switch away or close it.
- Battery Saver Mode: Automatically pauses rotation and background activity when running on battery below your chosen threshold (10%, 15%, 20%, or 25%), resuming once plugged into power or recharged.
- Respects Your Manual Pause: Activity Gate never overwrites your manual per-display pause state—any monitor you paused yourself stays paused when your game or presentation ends.

🖥️ Multi-Monitor Experience & macOS Speed
- Hardware Display Names: Every monitor is now labeled with its real name (e.g., Display 1 (U34G2G1) or Display 2 (Studio Display)) across the tray menu and the Tune Image window, so you always know which screen you are controlling.
- Per-Screen macOS Menu Bar: On macOS setups with "Displays have separate Spaces" enabled, clicking the Spice menu bar icon on any monitor now shows a flat menu that controls that specific display directly—no submenus required.
- Active-Display Window Placement: Opening Preferences, Tune Image, or About Spice now centers the window on the screen under your cursor instead of always jumping back to your primary monitor.
- Instant Preferences on macOS: Eliminated the 2–3 second delay when opening the Preferences window on macOS.

🐛 Bug Fixes & System Stability
- Compact-Screen Settings Scrolling (#141): Fixed an issue on smaller laptop displays (such as 13" MacBooks) where long provider query and collection lists (Wallhaven, Pexels, Wikimedia, Local Folder, Google Photos, and Favorites) were cut off instead of scrolling smoothly with the panel.
- Browser Extension "Add Collection" Dialog: Fixed an issue where adding a collection from the Chrome, Firefox, or Safari extension while Preferences was closed could fail to open or appear narrower than normal.
- Non-Disruptive Display Rearrangement: Rearranging monitors or changing your primary display now updates tray labels and window bounds in place without resetting the current wallpaper on each screen.

📦 Installation

For macOS:
- Homebrew (Recommended):
  brew tap dixieflatline76/spice
  brew install --cask spice
- Direct Download: Download Spice-2.8.0-macos-arm64.dmg from the assets below, open it, and drag Spice.app into Applications.
- Mac App Store: Update directly via the Mac App Store.

For Windows:
- Winget (Recommended):
  winget install dixieflatline76.Spice
- Microsoft Store: Update directly from the Microsoft Store.
- Installer: Download Spice-Setup-2.8.0-windows-amd64.exe from the assets below.
- Portable: Download Spice-2.8.0-windows-amd64.exe to run without installing.

Browser Extensions:
- Safari: Included with the macOS app.
- Chrome: Install from the Chrome Web Store.
- Firefox: Install from the Firefox Add-ons page.

💬 Feedback
Running into any issues or have feedback on Activity Gate or multi-monitor behavior? Let us know at GitHub Issues or reach out in discussions. Thank you for supporting open-access art and independent software! 🌶️✨
